text: Wi'an -an Jibriila- Muhammadu (yo Alla Juulu e makko O hisna mo): pellet, Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen ɓe jippantaako hoore-maɓɓe, anndu ko ɓe jipporta ko e Yamaruyee Alla, ko Alla heeranii ko men jaɓɓoto kon immorde e fiyaake Laakara, e ko men acci ɗum immorde e fiyaake aduna, e kon ko woni hakkunde aduna e Laakara, Joomi maaɗa wonaali -an Nulaaɗo- yejjitoowo huunde.
